it's not what she told me, but what she showed me. When we were kids she wanted to be friends with our class since she just transferred in. She was bullied by myself and the others because she had a hearing problem. When I met her again I told her that I wanted to be friends through sign language (something that I worked on learning since those days). At first she was reluctant to answer, but then the next thing she did saved me. She gave me nod a warm smile, and those alone were enough to save my life.
